headline: Median sale prices are up 2.2% YoY nationally; 39 of 50 metros have more price cuts than a year ago.

metric_registry.label: Median sale price
metric_registry.note: Not seasonally adjusted, so compare YoY

metric_registry.label: Sold above list
metric_registry.note: Share of sales above the original list price

metric_registry.label: Listings with price drops
metric_registry.note: Share of active listings with a price drop

brief.text: As of August 2026, the national median sale price stood at $398,596, up 2.2% year over year, while inventory rose 1.7% to 1,141,713 listings. Median days on market increased by 1.0 day to 50, and the price drops share climbed to 19.5%, up 0.6 pp from a year ago, with 39 of 50 tracked metros seeing more price cuts than last year. The top alert affects 20 metros where monthly payments rose at least 10% year over year, led by Chicago, IL (+13%) and New York, NY (+12%). A second alert flags 3 metros with median prices down at least 3% year over year, including Austin, TX (-6.3%) and Seattle, WA (-5.3%). The 30-year mortgage rate was 7.03%, up 0.08 pp over the past week and above the 6.3% rate seen a year ago. The national market carries a 'Cool' temperature score of 24 relative to its own 3-year history.
key_points: National median price up 2.2% YoY; inventory up 1.7%.
20 metros show monthly payments up 10%+ YoY.
Mortgage rate at 7.03%, up from 6.3% last year.
